caption: One continuous wildlife scene in the same open African savanna under warm daylight. The invariant environment is dry golden grass, scattered acacia trees, distant low hills, and a wide natural horizon. The invariant subject is the same group of large savanna animals moving through the same grassland without changing species or setting.
invariant_caption: The same African savanna remains visible with golden grass, acacia trees, distant hills, warm daylight, and the same group of large savanna animals.
contrast_caption: The scene changes to a city street, zoo enclosure, forest, beach, indoor room, different animal species, or nighttime setting.
